Massive Fire Hits Tondo’s  Community... 
A huge fire is currently engulfing the densely populated slum area of “Happyland” in #Tondo, Manila.

#Manila #Philippines 
https://t.co/MwvvDCtEzt
https://t.co/RX0gSHeiAi
https://t.co/rKsDeTi3Ki 
📌According to the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), the blaze was first reported at 9:47 a.m. and was immediately raised to the first alarm.
Within just one minute, it escalated to the second alarm as flames spread rapidly through the area, which was composed mostly of closely packed shanties made of lightweight materials.
By 9:55 a.m., the situation had worsened, prompting authorities to raise the fire to the third alarm.
